comparison.objective: Candidate sorts cartons by open/closed state on a conveyor; PR-1694 rolls pastry to a specified length, thickness and evenness.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests synchronized grasping around articulated flaps and level transport of loose contents. PR-1694 tests bimanual rolling-pin leveling and repeated controlled deformation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires open cartons deposited intact and closed cartons passed untouched. PR-1694 requires a sufficiently long, uniformly 3 mm sheet without damaged ends and a released, level pin.
comparison.reason: Rigid moving-object rejection and deformable thickness control are different tested abilities. No material rubric detail is missing.
